entries.name: GeoJSON geographic feature interchange
entries.versionBasis: RFC header; no separate authoritative JSON Schema claimed.

licence.basis: RFC copyright notice invokes BCP 78 and the Trust Legal Provisions in effect at publication. Preserve document notices; extracted Code Components use the specified BSD terms. Not a blanket BSD licence on prose.

norn.overlap: Geometry/Feature/FeatureCollection representation, WGS84 coordinates; not postal address or political boundary authority.

priority.reason: Addresses and regions are needed on every party.

entries.notes: RFC defines JSON representation but is not itself a JSON Schema. Third-party validators were not promoted to IETF authority; OGC JSON-FG is separately catalogued and is not identical to GeoJSON. Redistribution: license-conditions.

entries.name: ISO 3166-1 country codes: Debian iso-codes snapshot
entries.publisher: Debian iso-codes team; underlying identifiers ISO 3166/MA
entries.versionBasis: Tagged v4.20.1 JSON verified; CHANGELOG.md gives 2026-01-01. This is a compilation release, not ISO edition date.

licence.basis: REUSE.toml explicitly assigns data/*json LGPL-2.1-or-later; retain notices, licence and corresponding source/modifications under its conditions. This is Debian's compilation grant, not a licence to ISO publications.

norn.overlap: Country code identity for Party addresses; labels are source labels, not tenant display policy.

priority.reason: Countries on every address, tax and customs record.

entries.name: OGC Features and Geometries JSON (JSON-FG) schemas
entries.versionBasis: Schema description says version 1.0.0; schema repository README says posted 2026-04-30. Unversioned URLs intentionally evolve; not immutable pins.

licence.basis: Authoring GitHub repository has Apache-2.0 LICENSE, while official schema distribution README points to OGC policies. Exact grant/provenance linkage for the hosted schema closure must be checked before redistribution; do not infer from a general open-standards claim.

norn.overlap: GeoJSON-compatible extensions for CRS, geometry and time; distinct from RFC 7946, not a Core promotion.

priority.reason: Addresses and regions are needed on every party.
